text: Oh, absolutely. Because nothing says "dedication to oral hygiene" like asking a stranger about their dental tools while simultaneously promoting the revolutionary fitness breakthrough of shaking a piece of plastic until your wrist falls off. It’s truly the pinnacle of human innovation: replacing the grueling, sweat-inducing labor of actual exercise with the sheer, unadulterated power of wrist flicks. Who needs a gym when you can just aggressively shake a dumbbell for ten minutes and expect to look like Michelangelo’s David? It’s not just effortlessness; it’s a miracle. And while you’re busy carving your body into a statue with your pinky finger, don’t forget to brush. After all, if you’re going to achieve a Greek physique, you might as well have a Greek smile, even if it’s just from the sheer exhaustion of pretending that shaking a plastic weight counts as a workout.
